verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only fixed built-in automations, not a user-defined rule engine. Motion reshuffles schedules, unblocks dependent tasks and alerts on at-risk work on its own, and the daily meeting limit is a single setting rather than a general trigger-action rule. The 'AI Workflow Builder' builds workflows from SOPs without any documented event triggers, and Zapier is an external tool where any rules would be defined outside Motion.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
